evidence.reason: The finding identifies a real implementation error: systemd distinguishes escaped %i from unescaped %I, but _expand_instance substitutes the raw escaped instance for both. For a unit such as ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket, %I.service should resolve to crq-tick.service, while the current code yields crq\x2dtick.service and drops the dependency edge. This is ordinary code correctness under stable systemd specifier semantics, not a new requirement.
